sentences.en: The dwindling supply led to great anxiety in the community.
sentences.zh: 供应的减少让整个社区都感到非常焦虑。

sentences.en: Our savings dwindled to just a few hundred dollars.
sentences.zh: 我们的积蓄只剩下几百美元了。

sentences.en: My hope of seeing her again dwindles every day.
sentences.zh: 每天见到她的希望都在逐渐消失。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：d+wind（风）+le→随风而去，越来越小→缩小
